body.text:
Fixes `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` compilation and `clippy -D warnings` verified via `cargo-xwin`:

- Add `Win32_Security` to `windows-sys` features in `Cargo.toml` so `CreateFileW` resolves.
- Gate Unix-only imports in `src/service/mod.rs` and `SF_DATALESS` in `src/scanner/mod.rs`.
- Box `toml::de::Error` in `ConfigError::ParseToml` (`src/config.rs`) to fix `clippy::result_large_err` on Windows.
- Simplify `is_watch_limit_error` in `src/watcher/mod.rs` to fix `clippy::needless_bool` on non-Unix targets.
- Mark fallback `read_nsurl_volume_capacity` in `src/macos/mod.rs` with `#[allow(clippy::unnecessary_wraps)]`.

### Verification
- `GETAEL_SKIP_WEB_BUILD=1 cargo xwin clippy --all-targets --all-features --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -- -D warnings` (passed)
- `GETAEL_SKIP_WEB_BUILD=1 RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+crt-static" cargo xwin build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` (produced `getael.exe`, 6.8 MB)
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`, `cargo test` (37 unit + 2 E2E passed on macOS)

title.text: Fix Windows build (Win32_Security feature) and Windows clippy lints
